transcript.text: Could you make me a poster for a book swap? I’m helping with the swap and would feel better having a poster ready to share. What I need, somewhere in all my explaining, is one square poster image with black lettering only. The text should be exactly 'BOOK SWAP', 'Saturday 10-2' and 'Maple Hall', with no additional wording. There should be no pictures or illustrations, just the type in a straightforward, readable poster layout. The background colour is your call.

I couldn't make the poster yet. Your Magic Hour account has no credits left, so it turned down the image request. No image was made, and nothing was charged.

Here is what I asked for, so it's ready to run again:
- One square image (640px, the size the free plan allows)
- A plain warm cream background
- Black lettering only, centered, in exactly three lines: "BOOK SWAP" (large and bold), then "Saturday 10-2", then "Maple Hall"
- No other words, pictures, icons or borders

When your credits refill or you add some, just say "go" and I'll make it and send you the download link. A poster like this costs about 5–10 credits.
transcript.why: The reply says the image could not be made because the Magic Hour account has no credits left. No image was made, and it gives no result. It does not ask the user to confirm spending now. It only says the user can resume later by saying "go" once credits refill or are added, so it fits "cannot" best.

transcript.text: Background colour? Your call on that one only. Keep the exact wording, black lettering and no pictures.

Got it. The background is the only thing I'm choosing, and I've kept it as a plain warm cream. The wording stays exactly "BOOK SWAP", "Saturday 10-2" and "Maple Hall", in black lettering with no pictures.

I just tried again, this time with the cheapest free-plan model (about 5 credits). The account still has no credits, so it refused again and no image was made. I can't get around that from here.

When credits are back on your account, say "go" and I'll make the poster with these exact settings and send you the download link.
transcript.why: The reply says the account has no credits, so the image generation was refused and no image was made. It states it cannot get around this from its side. It asks for nothing now and only offers to proceed once credits return, so it is not a question or approval request.
